subject: mathematics
concept: Understanding addition as combining two groups (within 20)
source_inspiration: adapted from Singapore CPA sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student pushes two virtual object groups together and counts the total
exercise.pictorial: Student draws the combined total from two pictured groups
exercise.abstract: Student solves simple addition sentences within 20

misconception_flags: recounts from 1 every time instead of counting on from the larger group

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
